text: 据央视，两岸人工智能融合发展创新论坛7月18日上午在上海世博中心举行。2026世界人工智能大会框架下，由海峡经济科技合作中心牵头筹办的两岸人工智能融合发展创新论坛及配套展览在上海举办，活动以“智领新程 融创未来”为主题。本次论坛联合临港新片区管委会、清华大学相关院系、台湾区电机电子工业同业公会多方共同筹办，约150位各界代表参会，8位两岸业内权威嘉宾围绕人工智能赋能制造、医疗两大板块开展研讨，搭建高端对话平台。展区汇集联发科、工业富联等二十余家台资科创企业，展出AI芯片、智能驾驶、元宇宙等前沿技术。临港新片区同步推介产业扶持政策。本次活动打通两岸科创交流
text_en: According to CCTV, the Cross-Strait AI Integration and Development Innovation Forum was held on the morning of July 18 at the Shanghai World Expo Center. Under the framework of the 2026 World AI Conference, the forum and accompanying exhibition, organized by the Cross-Strait Economic, Science and Technology Cooperation Center, were held in Shanghai under the theme 'AI Leads New Horizons, Integration Creates the Future.' Jointly organized with the Lin-gang Special Area Administration, relevant Tsinghua University departments, and the Taiwan Electrical and Electronic Manufacturers' Association, the event brought together about 150 representatives. Eight authoritative guests from both sides discussed AI empowerment in manufacturing and healthcare, building a high-level dialogue platform. The exhibition area gathered over 20 Taiwan-invested tech companies including MediaTek and Foxconn Industrial Internet, showcasing AI chips, intelligent driving, the metaverse, and other cutting-edge technologies. The Lin-gang Special Area concurrently promoted industrial support policies. This event opened up cross-strait tech exchanges.
